## Descripción
Why use p and q when I can use more? Connect with `nc xebec.cylabacademy.net 20057`.

There's more prime factors than p and q, finding d is going to be different.
## solución 

```
┌──(jeex㉿LAPTOP-77F4GRAK)-[~]
└─$ nc xebec.cylabacademy.net 20057
c: 
n: 
e: 65537


c, n , e  = en el puerto

vamoa a la pajina 
y colocamos n 

y obtenemos eulers totiem

quitamos los espacios con un eco


eso es tn 



d = pow(e, -1, tn)
m = pow(c, d, n)

flag = bytes.fromhex( hex(m)[2:] ).decode()
```
